report:
Thyroid, right lobe and isthmus, hemithyroidectomy

Received in formalin is a right hemithyroidectomy specimen weighing 28 g and measuring right lobe 5 x 3 x 2 cm, left lobe 4.5 x 2.5 x 2 cm, isthmus 2 x 1.5 x 0.8 cm. The thyroid capsule is intact. Sectioning shows a firm, pale white infiltrative mass in the right lobe measuring 35 x 28 x 22 mm. The background parenchyma is unremarkable. Representative sections are taken in 10 blocks.

(1-5) Right lobe tumour with capsule and posterior margin.
(6) Isthmus.
(7-8) Left lobe.
(9-10) Central compartment lymph nodes.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Right lobectomy with isthmusectomy (hemithyroidectomy)
- Tumour site: Right lobe
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour size: 35 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 35 x 28 x 22 mm

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Encapsulated angioinvasive follicular carcinoma
- Mitotic count (per 2 mm2): Less than 3 mitoses per 2 mm2 (1 per 2 mm2)
- Tumour necrosis: Not identified
- Angioinvasion: Extensive (>= 4 vessels)
- Lymphatic invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Extrathyroidal extension: Gross, invading only strap muscles
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the thyroid show encapsulated angioinvasive follicular carcinoma in the right lobe. A follicular-patterned neoplasm lacking papillary-like nuclear features shows capsular and/or vascular invasion.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Involved by carcinoma (anterior strap muscle interface)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3b

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: None identified

THYROID, right lobe and isthmus, hemithyroidectomy:
- ENCAPSULATED ANGIOINVASIVE FOLLICULAR CARCINOMA, 35 mm
- gross extrathyroidal extension into strap muscles
- Surgical margin involved by carcinoma (anterior strap muscle interface)
- pT3b (AJCC 8th edition).
